import re,os
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def grab(label,h,w,text):
    i=text.find(label+' (%dx%d):'%(h,w))
    if i<0: return None
    seg=text[i+len(label):]
    i2=seg.find('\n')+1
    seg=seg[i2:]
    rows=[]
    for line in seg.split('\n')[:h]:
        rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
    return rows
def parse(text):
    out={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair (\d+) (input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):',text):
        k=m[1]; h=int(m[4]); w=int(m[5])
        rows=grab(k,h,w,text)
        if rows and len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows):
            out[k if 'Demo' not in k else 'd%s_%s'%(m[2],m[3])]=rows
    return out
